prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" personal injury attorney in Chicago, as the right choice depends on your specific accident details, injuries, and whether the case settles or goes to trial. Several prominent Chicago law firms and attorneys have established track records for handling car accident claims: Disparti Law Group Accident & Injury Lawyers
Disparti Law Group Accident & Injury Lawyers: Founded by Larry Disparti, this firm has over 30 attorneys and has recovered over $2 billion for clients across Illinois, handling car, truck, and motorcycle crashes. Disparti Law Group Accident & Injury Lawyers
Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C.: A well-known Chicago personal injury firm holding a 4.8-star rating on Google with extensive experience litigating car accidents, medical malpractice, and serious injuries. Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C.
Malman Law: Operating in Chicago for over 30 years, this firm has helped more than 20,000 injured clients across vehicle, truck, and personal injury practice areas. Malman Law
Smith LaCien LLP: Led by trial lawyers Todd Smith and Brian LaCien, recognized for high-value verdicts and settlements in catastrophic motor vehicle and transport accidents. Smith LaCien
Briskman Briskman & Greenberg: Practicing in Chicago since 1985, focusing on personalized client relationships and multi-million dollar recoveries for car and personal injury claims. Briskman Briskman & Greenberg
Contingency Fee Basis: Reputable firms like Ankin Law and others charge $0 upfront fees and only collect a percentage if they win or settle your case. Schuerger Shunnarah Trial Attorneys +1
Trial Experience: Ask whether the attorney is prepared to take your case to a jury if the insurance company offers a lowball settlement. Disparti Law Group Accident & Injury Lawyers
Specialized Knowledge: If your crash involves a commercial truck, rideshare (Uber/Lyft), or multi-vehicle pileup, look for a firm with specific experience in those domains. McNabola & Associates, LLC +1
What type of vehicle crash was it (e.g., standard car, commercial truck, rideshare)?
How severe are the injuries or property damage?
Are you looking for a firm that settles quickly or one that aggressively takes cases to trial?
